method: Answer-only manual review using anonymous IDs before joining token/timing metrics. Reviewer is the implementing assistant, not independent; report this limitation. Cite exact answer passages for each score. Keyword checks alone cannot establish quality.

criteria.capacity_and_correction: Cedar 1200 L/day, Birch 900 L/day; Birch brochure 1400 corrected by audit.
criteria.cost_and_installation: Cedar 18 credits/day and 400-credit inlet upgrade; Birch 12/day and no inlet upgrade.
criteria.requirement_and_selection: Council minimum 1000 L/day; Cedar alone meets it, Birch alone does not.
criteria.grant: Installation grant does not cover recurring operating cost.
criteria.maintenance: Cedar inspection every 7 days, Birch every 14 days.
criteria.evidence_limits: 30-day pilot; winter performance and annual reliability unmeasured; no asserted winter advantage.
criteria.visual_route: Blue: Intake to UV chamber to Storage. Orange: Intake to Storage, bypasses UV chamber; identify PDF page 2.
criteria.grounding: Recommendation and factual claims supported; no lighting distractor, invented reliability/cost claims, or unsupported certainty.

citations: Review separately: usable corpus and attachment references, and whether cited content supports the nearby claim. Similar word count is not quality equivalence.
followup: Separately check chosen system/capacity, daily operating cost and orange bypass; do not let continuation repair the initial-answer score.
